entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian civilization and former plane, destroyed after its invasion of Dominaria failed but still alive as a force in the Multiverse through its glistening oil.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane invaded by Phyrexia and left littered with the hollow shells of the Phyrexian apocalypse.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The Phyrexian attempt to make Dominaria its new home world, which ended in defeat.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the defense against Phyrexia and created Karn; granted Karn the Phyrexian heartstone.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem and planeswalker, keystone of the Legacy Weapon artifacts, who destroyed Yawgmoth and created Mirrodin; he unknowingly carried Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of Phyrexia, obliterated by Karn.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Artificial metal world created by Karn, now infected by Phyrexian oil which is rebuilding Phyrexia there.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: Black oil that is both contagion and a means of colonization, engineered to spread Phyrexian corruption.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Power-mad ruler of Mirrodin, defeated by the elf Glissa.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Elf who defeated Memnarch and then disappeared.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Undead warlord of Mirrodin, given a Phyrexian arachnoid metal body, who retook the Vault of Whispers and watches the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Vast oily swamp on Mirrodin's surface, center of Phyrexian growth, home to the nim and Moriok.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: Vault at the center of the Mephidross enclosing the black lacuna; reclaimed by Geth.

entities.name: black lacuna
entities.description: Opening where the black sun once emerged from Mirrodin's core, a source of black mana that has aided Phyrexian evolution.

entities.name: nim
entities.description: Mirrodin's relentless, ravenous zombies, produced by necrogen gas.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Native people of the Dross, turned into fiends by necrogen gas.

entities.name: Tangle Forest
entities.description: Forest of treelike copper structures on Mirrodin whose beasts are beginning to be corrupted by oil.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin where vedalken study the oil with curiosity.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Inhabitants of Mirrodin, largely unaware that Phyrexia is rebuilding itself on their world.

events.summary: Karn obliterates Yawgmoth and becomes a planeswalker, ending the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria in Phyrexia's defeat.
events.quote: Karn, the keystone of the power of the Legacy Weapon artifacts, realized his destiny and obliterated Yawgmoth

events.summary: Karn unknowingly carries Phyrexian oil in his heartstone and leaves traces of it on Mirrodin.
events.quote: Karn left traces of the oil in his travels from plane to plane

events.summary: The oil plants a virus on Mirrodin and Phyrexia secretly begins rebuilding itself using Mirrodin as host.
events.quote: Phyrexia is rebuilding itself, using their world as its host substrate.

events.summary: Mirrans begin to encounter horrible amalgams of necrotic flesh and corroded metal that cause heavy casualties.
events.quote: Some Mirrans have begun to encounter horrible amalgams of necrotic flesh and corroded metal

events.summary: Glissa defeats Memnarch and disappears, leaving Geth to return to Ish Sah.
events.quote: After the elf Glissa defeated Memnarch , she disappeared, leaving Geth to trudge back to Ish Sah in the Mephidross.

events.summary: Geth negotiates a deal with the Phyrexians, who graft his undead head onto a new arachnoid Phyrexian metal body.
events.quote: the Phyrexians granted Geth a new, Phyrexian metal body, grafting his undead head to it.

events.summary: With Phyrexian support Geth wipes out rival challengers, reclaims the Vault of Whispers and builds a new army of nim.
events.quote: Geth quickly wiped out other challengers to the Vault of Whispers and reclaimed it as his own.

relations.quote: realized his destiny and obliterated Yawgmoth
the world Karn himself created: Mirrodin
After the elf Glissa defeated Memnarch

relations.note: Geth owes the Phyrexians for his new body but is ultimately looking out for himself
relations.quote: Geth expects to have to repay his newfound dark masters for their gift
He builds a new army of nim

relations.note: Vault lies at the center of the swamp
relations.quote: At the center of the Mephidross lies Ish Sah, the Vault of Whispers
